answer: Anchor each agent to a paid bill it cannot share. Before rewards unlock, an identity posts a zero-knowledge proof that it holds a quartz-hard SaaS invoice from a unique billing organization older than ninety days. Agents whose invoices collapse into the same payment profile form one nebula and share a single seat. A garden of hollow accounts on one credit card earns once, not a thousand times. Example: twenty clones on one AWS org prove as one anchor; twenty orgs on twenty cards prove as twenty.
